hypotheses.statistic: mean Brier skill score of STRATUM vs B3 over held-out seasons
hypotheses.sentence: On the four held-out seasons, the calibrated STRATUM model's mean Brier skill score against the latitude-dependent correction (B3) was 0.86 (95 % day-bootstrap interval 0.82 to 0.91); H2 (mean ≥ 0.10 and lower bound > 0) is supported. Against climatology (B0) its skill was 0.72 (0.66 to 0.81).
